Fishermen Warning for Maharashtra - Goa Coast
(Valid for next five days from 18/06/2024 to 22/06/2024)
Warning for coastal areas for North- Maharashtra coast (upto 75km from the coast) :-
Squally weather with wind speed 35 kmph to 45 kmph gusting to 55 kmph likely to prevail along and off North Maharashtra coast on
20th to 22nd June.
Fishermen are advised not to venture along & off North Maharashtra coast during above mentioned period.
Warning for coastal areas for South Maharashtra-Goa coast (upto 75km from the coast) :-
Squally weather with wind speed 35 kmph to 45 kmph gusting to 55 kmph likely to prevail along and off South Maharashtra-Goa
coast on 20th to 22nd June.
Fishermen are advised not to venture along & off South Maharashtra-Goa coast during above mentioned period.
